name: SCC-v1
frozen_commit_label: before Vaihingen external confirmation; SCC-v1 may not be modified after this record

model.identity: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 quick-GELU; OpenCLIP/timm converted state_dict

group_a_templates: a region of {class} viewed from above

visual_prototype_construction.source: weakly supervised regions (SAM3 source weak label)
visual_prototype_construction.region_features: frozen OpenAI CLIP region features (6000x512 float16 cache, sha256 ac75c0be...)

scc_formula.support_shift: b(x) = mean_{c in S}[ A_c(x) - T_c(x) ] (arithmetic mean over supported classes)
scc_formula.k0_rule: if |S| = 0, SCC strictly degenerates to Text-only
scc_formula.k6_rule: if all classes supported, all classes subtract the same b(x), so argmax strictly equals C2

support_definition.supported: class with an existing weakly-supervised visual prototype
support_definition.unsupported: class without a visual prototype; text prototype only

normalization.rule: all prototypes L2 normalized before use; no temperature, no threshold, no beta, no k-dependent rule, no hard gating
normalization.centering: arithmetic mean only (mean -> median is forbidden)

love_da_status.label: development-after-P0
love_da_status.meaning: LoveDA heldout was used to discover P1 and to develop SCC; SCC results on LoveDA are method-development evidence, NOT blind confirmation

final_love_da_metrics.note: H aggregated as mean over subsets of per-subset H (mean(H_i)); not H(mean(S), mean(U)).

forbidden_modifications: any modification based on any future GT
